## Our Business Units
![Grinding Techniques](http://www.grindtech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Metal-Industries.jpg)
### Metal Industries
### Metal Industries
The Steel and Precision Industry both require high-quality products that produce optimum results with less operating times for increased productivity. Grinding Techniques offer a wide range of innovative abrasive products, engineered and manufactured to maximise output and profit in these Industries.
View More
![Grinding Techniques](http://www.grindtech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Industrial-Trade.jpg)
### Industrial Trade
### Industrial Trade
From automotive body repairs to home projects, Grinding Techniques provide product solutions to cover various applications within the Industrial Trade.
View More
![Grinding Techniques](http://www.grindtech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/WEBSITE-Tyrolit-Power53.jpg)
### Tyrolit Power
### Tyrolit Power
Tyrolit Power is specifically designed and tested for use on composite materials. Offering unmatchable lifetime and highly efficient machining processes, we provide a complete solution inclusive of onsite technical support, and service level agreements.
[View More](https://www.grindtech.com/tyrolit-power/)
![Tyrolit Construction](http://www.grindtech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/WEBSITE-Tyrolit-Construction-1.jpg)
### Tyrolit Construction
TYROLIT CONSTRUCTION offers powerful solutions for professionals in concrete cutting and controlled demolition. Our range selection includes diamond tools and machines, system solutions for floor grinding, machines, and tools for grinding uneven surfaces, and special construction solutions.
[View More](https://www.grindtech.com/tyrolit-construction/)
### GRINDING TECHNIQUES (Pty) Ltd A Company of the TYROLIT Group
Founded in 1981 to supply specialised grinding wheels and other abrasive products to the industrial market, the Company has grown to become a major force in Industrial Abrasive supply in South Africa. In addition to forming part of the global TYROLIT Group, our locally manufactured products are exported to satisfied customers world-wide.
[Read More](https://www.grindtech.com/about-us/)
### The Tyrolit Group Leading abrasives manufacturer
TYROLIT is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of grinding and dressing tools as well as a system provider for the construction industry. Headquartered in Schwaz (Austria), the family-owned business combines the strengths of being a part of the dynamic Swarovski Group with over a century’s worth of individual corporate and technological experience.
[Read More](https://www.grindtech.com/tyrolit-group/)

# GRINDING TECHNIQUES – A Company of the TYROLIT Group
Grinding Techniques was founded in Chamdor (Krugersdorp) in 1981. We supply specialised grinding products for the industrial market and our company has developed into an important force in the industrial abrasive market.
We have an extensive range of high quality cut-off and grinding wheels, specialised industrial diamond tools and a wide range of surface finishing tools so with us, you will always find the right product for your application. All of our tools are manufactured locally in accordance with international standards (ISO, EN and OSA) and our products are also exported to satisfied customers all over the world.
We have three key focus areas which are the metal industries, industrial trade industry and the quartz industries. These areas are all broken down further into more niche areas and we supply various tools to these sectors, which are of the utmost standard. In the metal industries, we focus on extremely high quality products that focus on maximum output at affordable costs. In the industrial sector we cover various applications from home projects, to the automotive industry. Lastly, in the quarts sector we focus on precision for the natural and artificial stone industry.
We offer realistic minimum quantities with competitive production times, technological expertise and attractive prices. Our company is a complete package focused on service and customer satisfaction therefore we are perfectly positioned to serve and supply the abrasive market. We look forward to the opportunity of meeting your abrasive requirements in a mutually beneficial partnership.
Since 2014 Grinding Techniques is an important part of the global  
[TYROLIT Group](https://www.tyrolit.group/).  
The  
[TYROLIT Group](https://www.tyrolit.group/)  
are one of the world’s leading manufacturers of grinding and dressing tools. They are a system for the construction industry based in Austria.

## GRINDING TECHNIQUES – A TYROLIT Company Group
Contact Us Today! Grinding Techniques was founded in Chamdor (Krugersdorp) in 1981. We supply specialised grinding products for the industrial market and our company has developed into an important force in the industrial abrasive market.
We have an extensive range of high quality cut-off and grinding wheels, specialised industrial diamond tools and a wide range of surface finishing tools so with us, you will always find the right product for your application. All of our tools are manufactured locally in accordance with international standards (ISO, EN and OSA) and our products are also exported to satisfied customers all over the world.
We have three key focus areas which are the metal industries, industrial trade industry and the quartz industries. These areas are all broken down further into more niche areas and we supply various tools to these sectors, which are of the utmost standard. In the metal industries, we focus on extremely high quality products that focus on maximum output at affordable costs. In the industrial sector we cover various applications from home projects, to the automotive industry. Lastly, in the quarts sector we focus on precision for the natural and artificial stone industry.
We offer realistic minimum quantities with competitive production times, technological expertise and attractive prices. Our company is a complete package focused on service and customer satisfaction therefore we are perfectly positioned to serve and supply the abrasive market. We look forward to the opportunity of meeting your abrasive requirements in a mutually beneficial partnership.
Since 2014 Grinding Techniques is an important part of the global [TYROLIT Group](https://www.tyrolit.group/). The TYROLIT Group are one of the world’s leading manufacturers of grinding and dressing tools. They are a system for the construction industry based in Austria.
